recurringPatterns.pattern: Two-beat evidentiary hedge, several times per chapter, the default sentence engine
instances: Jebel Sahaba establishes a concentration of violent injury...; it cannot establish a general rate...
Its presence establishes investment in controlled space. It does not identify an enemy...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Paired antithesis about institutions restraining one violence while enlarging another, restated in nearly identical grammar in almost every chapter
instances: Assyrian expansion created a political order that restrained some violence by organizing larger forms of coercion.
The volume of violence could fall in one relationship while its legitimacy expanded in another.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapters close with a long summarizing paragraph reciting the three case studies then an aphoristic clause
instances: Jericho's wall indicates recognition of vulnerability...; Talheim's mass burial records the failure of such protection; Göbekli Tepe demonstrates...
Yuan administration in northern China translated Mongol movement...; Mamluk resistance at Ayn Jalut...

recurringPatterns.pattern: The 'chain' metaphor for administration introduced as fresh across chapters 4, 8, 10, 11, 12
instances: The practical chain ran from stores to officials, officials to labour...
The sequence ran from pasture to road, from road to river crossing...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Isolated one-sentence paragraphs as rhetorical drops restating the preceding paragraph
instances: It did not remove that force from the frontier.
Safety was distributed through political membership.

summary: Disciplined, learned; a prose machine that repeats itself; editorial residue survives (ch7 quotes ch4's opening sentence as a source, ch12 refers to itself and ch14 by number, two sentences appear twice verbatim); voice uniform and gray.
